classifications.reason: The contract expressly includes a combination, matching the admitting words 'two or more vehicles coupled together', and no exception removes that class.
The exception for devices moved by human power describes the human-powered devices in this class's contract.
The vehicle definition expressly excepts electric bicycles, which this class identifies according to the jurisdiction's taxonomy.
The vehicle definition expressly names electric scooters as an exception.
The contract does not require exclusive stationary-rail use, so it permits non-excepted coupled combinations that satisfy the admitted combination branch of ru.trailer_or_combination.
The contract describes a person rather than two or more coupled vehicles, including when that person uses a wheelchair or another pedestrian device.
A pedestrian who is visibly a child is a person, not the coupled vehicles required by the admitting words.
The contract describes a pedestrian with specified assistance, none of which makes that person two or more coupled vehicles.
Any member admitted as two or more coupled vehicles necessarily satisfies the combination branch of the quoted ru.trailer_or_combination contract.
Any truck-class road user admitted by the coupled-vehicles definition is itself a combination and therefore carries ru.trailer_or_combination under its quoted contract.
Any bus-class road user admitted by the definition must be a combination, which the quoted ru.trailer_or_combination contract expressly covers.
School-bus designation alone does not satisfy the definition, and every admitted school-bus-class combination satisfies the covering contract's combination branch.
Transit service alone does not satisfy the definition, and every admitted transit-bus-class combination carries ru.trailer_or_combination under the quoted contract.
For either branch of this class's contract, an admitted road user must be a coupled combination and thus satisfy the covering contract's combination branch.
Passenger-for-hire status does not establish a combination, while every admitted taxicab-class combination satisfies the quoted covering contract.
Commercial mass or licensing does not establish coupling, and every admitted commercial-class combination carries ru.trailer_or_combination under its quoted contract.
Emergency designation alone does not establish a combination, and every admitted emergency-class combination satisfies the quoted covering contract without requiring responding conduct.
Fire-fighting function alone does not satisfy the definition, and any admitted fire-apparatus-class combination satisfies the covering contract's combination branch.
Official road service alone does not establish coupling, and every admitted official-class combination satisfies the quoted ru.trailer_or_combination contract.
Any motorcycle-class road user admitted as two or more coupled vehicles necessarily satisfies the combination branch of the quoted covering contract.
The posted words identify a moped as a vehicle without excepting that class, and any admitted moped-class combination necessarily satisfies the quoted covering contract.
